purpose: Run a cosmic-ray propagation code from a JSON run spec in a recorded environment and turn each run into one grid-node prediction (representation grid, the node in parameter_point) that the comparison gate and covariance_fit.py model tabulated-grid consume unchanged; translate a transport block (contracts ext_theory_spec.transport) into a USINE V3.5 run with every inexpressible item recorded, read USINE's local-flux tables into ratios of bin integrals, and serve USINE as the cr-provider/1 provider 'usine'; translate a transport block into a DRAGON2 run with every inexpressible item recorded and serve DRAGON2 as the cr-provider/1 provider 'dragon2' (ratios of bin integrals on ekn or rigidity bins); serve the hep-ml Gaussian-process emulator of USINE B/C (E2) as provider 'emulator', refusing points outside its training domain; optional, required by no skill

tools.name: DRAGON2 (https://github.com/cosmicrays/DRAGON2-Beta_version): run spec to XML and data directory, local-spectrum ASCII output to bin-averaged ratio predictions and to ratios of bin integrals (provider dragon2)
tested_versions: DRAGON2-Beta_version git cd588707fe03c76f19bda1b8092e136dcbe3fe90 (2021-09-30; configure.ac DRAGON 3.1.0), built 2026-10-15 on E2 with Homebrew GCC 15.2.0, GSL 2.8, CFITSIO 4.6.4 (autoconf 2.72, libtool 2.6.2): six runs recorded (B/C with convection, reacceleration, energy losses and decay off; illustrative production cross sections) and replayed offline (VALIDATION CR-PROPAGATION-DRAGON2)

the same build on E-crprop (macOS 27.2 arm64), 2026-10-28: six cr-propagation D1 runs translated from harmonized-v1-<item>.json (item-off, convection, decay with NUBASE2020 half-lives, reacceleration converted by transport_conventions.py, energy losses on Galprop gas and its item-off run) recorded and replayed offline, item effects compared with the B2 closed form and USINE V3.5 (VALIDATION CRPROP-D1); energy losses on gas without HII (BronfFerr, NS) are unphysical in cd588707 (the nuclear Coulomb loss diverges at n_HII = 0) and are refused by the translator; the provider passes C1's conformance checks live (HEP_DRAGON2_LIVE_TEST=1)

tools.name: USINE (https://gitlab.com/dmaurin/USINE, GPL-2.0, run as a separate program): transport block to initialisation file and cross-section tables, local-flux tables to ratios of bin integrals (provider usine)
tested_versions: USINE V3.5 (git tag V3.5, tag object 7197ddc1, commit fb53006db41d1a640bf1b5af1a4b0f899ca59673), built 2026-10-28 on E-crprop (macOS 27.2 arm64) with Apple clang 21.0.0 (clang-2100.0.123.102) against Homebrew ROOT 6.38.04 (C++17), cmake 4.3.2: seven runs translated from transport blocks (harmonized-v1 and the D1 items isotopic, convection, decay, reacceleration, losses, and a 1D run with a low break) recorded and replayed offline; a live rerun (HEP_USINE_LIVE_TEST=1) reproduces every recorded output within relative 1e-6; the provider passes C1's conformance checks live (VALIDATION CRPROP-B1); a transport block matching USINE's shipped example inputs/init.TEST.par (high break, USINE's own cross-section files and data-normalised abundances read in place) reproduces that example's B/C run in place within relative 1e-6 (identical tables), recorded and rerun live (VALIDATION CRPROP-B1X)

environment: E2 (docs/capability-matrix.md): macOS 26.5 arm64, Python 3.13.2 with numpy 2.5.3 and scipy 1.18.1; DRAGON2 built from source in a user work directory (no system-wide installation) with Homebrew GCC 15.2.0 (g++, gcc, gfortran), GSL 2.8 and CFITSIO 4.6.4, serial (no OpenMP); the build and each run are recorded as computational-run artifacts under tests/adapters/fixtures/cr_propagation/. The provider dragon2 runs DRAGON2 located through HEP_DRAGON2_BIN and HEP_DRAGON2_DATA and keeps each run under HEP_DRAGON2_RUN_DIR when set. No network at run time; the source was cloned once from GitHub (user-approved). USINE V3.5 built from source (gitlab.com/dmaurin/USINE tag V3.5) in a user work directory with Apple clang 21.0.0 against Homebrew ROOT 6.38.04, located through HEP_USINE_BIN and HEP_USINE_DATA (its inputs folder), runs kept under HEP_USINE_RUN_DIR when set; no USINE source or shipped input is copied into the plugin (GPL-2.0), fixtures hold only numbers computed by USINE runs and this adapter's own files. GALPROP was not obtained or run
status_rule: the adapter status is the lowest of its tools' statuses, so it stays proposed while GALPROP is proposed; DRAGON2 stays tested-in-declared-environment only while its recorded runs and the live rerun (HEP_DRAGON2_LIVE_TEST=1) pass on the declared build; another DRAGON2 commit or build is a new test; USINE stays tested-in-declared-environment only while its recorded runs and the live rerun (HEP_USINE_LIVE_TEST=1) pass on the declared V3.5 build, another commit or build is a new test; DRAGON2 energy losses run only on gas with HII > 0 (cd588707 diverges at n_HII = 0); a run that terminates is not a validated prediction, and the limit benchmark is a consistency check against a closed form, not a validation of the code

provider.description: one USINE V3.5 run per point (translator of the transport block; ILLUSTRATIVE cross sections of theory:cr-secondary-ratio, or USINE's own cross-section files and data-normalised abundances read in place from HEP_USINE_DATA), read into ratios of bin integrals of B/C, 10Be/9Be or Be/B on ekn or rigidity bins (r3 P2, P3); not decomposable; needs HEP_USINE_BIN and HEP_USINE_DATA; F1: a point may also set the one low break (R_break_gv, delta_below), the force-field potential of the data period 2011-05/2016-05 (phi_2011_2016_gv, USINE SolMod0DFF per isotope; top-of-atmosphere values: the declared modulation below, contracts 3.15.0, which passed the conformance gate of tools/provider_registry.py --conformance, rerun at provider version 0.3.0 and recorded with that version, contracts 3.16.0; recorded in each prediction) and the production channel 12C+H->11B (xs_norm, xs_slope, xs_threshold, USINE's fit-mode Norm, SlopeLE, EThresh)

modulation.implementation: USINE V3.5 SolMod0DFF: force field per isotope (Phi = |Z| phi / A) in USINE's own run, before the reader forms ratios (r3 P4)

provider.description: one DRAGON2 run per point (translator of the transport block, dragon2_translate.py over dragon2_run.py; ILLUSTRATIVE isotopic cross sections), read into ratios of bin integrals of B/C or 10Be/9Be on ekn or rigidity bins (r3 P2, P3); not decomposable; needs HEP_DRAGON2_BIN and HEP_DRAGON2_DATA. Sources (K3, escalation 12): DRAGON2 injects R^-gamma per unit momentum and keeps the abundances of its BaseModel_DRAGONxsec.source.param, so a transport must state spectrum_variable 'rigidity' (eta 0) and abundances 'dragon2:BaseModel_DRAGONxsec.source.param' (or leave them out, recorded); harmonized-v1's per-E_k/n injection and parent-list abundances are refused with the reason, never replaced. Tested in the declared environment (DRAGON2 cd588707, E-crprop; VALIDATION CRPROP-D1, CRPROP-D3) with these accepted, attributed differences against USINE V3.5 (maintainer decisions A1.11, A1.13; campaign report 8 item 13): (1) D1-1a item effects, DRAGON2 over the reference with the item on and off: decay, 10Be/9Be 13.3% against the B2 closed form and 11.3% against USINE below 1 GeV/n (B/C 0.13% and 0.02%), attributed to DRAGON2's finite gas layer (BronfFerr H2 59 pc, HI 115 pc) against the thin disc of both references (a 1D thick-gas diagnostic reproduces it within about 1% only in bins 3-5; bins 2 and 6 differ by about 3.5% and the residual above 1 GeV/n is 2-6%; D3's like-for-like USINE run with DRAGON2's gas agrees with the thick-gas factor within 0.41% in all 12 bins); reacceleration, B/C up to 5.7% (item effect 1.322 against USINE's 1.402 in 2-2.95 GV, 1.183 against 1.122 in the next bin) and 10Be/9Be up to 4.4%, attributed to the first-order zone conversion of transport_conventions.py (thin-disc 50 km/s run as Ptuskin94 whole-halo 15.81 km/s; relative error bound 0.517 on the second-order term, destruction/escape ratio 1.586) and the whole-halo vs thin-disc spatial difference, the second-order term not estimated; losses (on Galprop gas, D1-L), B/C up to 6.1% (0.815 against 0.867 in the lowest bin; 10Be/9Be 1.7%), attributed to DRAGON2's Coulomb loss on Galprop's HII against USINE's ionization-only reference, not quantified (Galprop's neutral column likely contributes as much); with HII in USINE (D3) the item effects agree within 3.0%. (2) D3-1, level 1 (each code as translated from the same block): B/C 38.2-40.8% for harmonized-v1, isotopic, convection, decay and reacceleration and 77.0% for the losses pair on Galprop gas, decomposed by USINE runs adding one DRAGON2 setting per step: gas column x1.054-1.087, helium target (He/H 0.11) x1.073-1.136, DRAGON2's inelastic cross sections x1.003-1.077, parent ratio O/C (DRAGON2 BaseModel 1.19-1.21 against 0.9) x1.104-1.110, injection convention (per momentum against per E_k/n) x1.000-1.031; their product times the matched residual equals the offset. (3) D3-3, matched level 1 (USINE given DRAGON2's gas columns, helium, inelastic cross sections, O/C and injection): within 0.59-0.67% for harmonized-v1, isotopic, convection and decay; reacceleration 17.0% in the lowest bin (item-effect ratio 0.834 in 2-2.95 GV, within the A1R first-order bound times USINE's item effect in every bin) and the losses pair 17.7% (Galprop's 2D gas geometry, not expressible in USINE's KisoVc models: with the gas scaled by the geometry factor 0.811 the matched runs agree within 1.9% and 3.3%). Escalation-11 caveats: the second-order reacceleration term is not estimated, the losses attribution is not quantified, and the thick-gas correction of the 10Be/9Be decay gap holds within about 1% only in bins 3-5 in D1 (D3's like-for-like run closes it in all bins). DRAGON2 enum note (escalation 10, likely upstream bug, not reported upstream; A1R): in cd588707 src/galaxy.cc:279-284 multiplies the D_pp constant by 4/3 when diff_reacc == 1, and src/include/constants.h:146-149 enumerates Ptuskin94 = 0, Ptuskin03 = 1, so the 4/3 commented 'Seo & Ptuskin' lands on type Ptuskin03 (against the comment of src/include/input.h:156): type Ptuskin94 has D_pp constant 1, 3/4 of USINE V3.5's 4/3 (inputs/init.Model1D.par:90) at equal V_A, D and w. The translator runs Ptuskin94 and converts V_A with transport_conventions.py's dragon2-ptuskin94 convention (constant 1), so the runs follow the code as it is (read from the source, not from its comments); a DRAGON2 commit that fixes the enum changes the constant and is a new test

Gaussian-process emulator of USINE B/C (hep-ml train_emulator.py, ml-artifact task surrogate, tests/adapters/fixtures/cr_propagation/e2) on the 20 rigidity bins 2-1000 GV of its training runs, transport fixed to its training transport, the USINE provider's DEFAULT_TRANSPORT as of usine 0.2.0 (L 4 kpc; requests compare the block by hash, so the 0.3.0 DEFAULT_TRANSPORT, which states the injection spectrum_variable and renders the same USINE inputs, is another block and is refused); points the stored DomainModel calls sparse or outside are refused (out-of-domain); emulator error as numerical uncertainty components; not decomposable; numpy and scipy only
